name: Personalized change monitoring v1
description: Semi-synthetic multi-day stories for identity, material-change, display-policy, relevance, and source-faithfulness evaluation.

profile.briefing_style: Report only meaningful changes in magical fashion.

fact_catalog.elf_f1: Moon-crystal toenail charms began appearing in Faraway Market.
fact_catalog.elf_f3: The second article repeats the first report without a new event.
fact_catalog.elf_f4: The Royal Tailors Guild adopted toenail charms for the winter uniform.

documents.title: Toenail magic becomes the new fashion in Faraway Market
documents.snippet: Moon-crystal charms appeared in a dozen tailor demonstrations.
documents.body: Moon-crystal toenail charms began appearing in Faraway Market. Twelve tailors demonstrated the style; no guild has adopted it yet.

documents.title: Faraway Market's new fashion is toenail magic
documents.snippet: A wire rewrite describes moon-crystal toenail charms and twelve tailors.
documents.body: Moon-crystal toenail charms are the new Faraway Market fashion, according to the same twelve demonstrations reported yesterday. No later action is described.

documents.title: Royal Tailors Guild adopts toenail charms for winter uniforms
documents.snippet: The voluntary trend becomes official guild dress.
documents.body: The Royal Tailors Guild adopted moon-crystal toenail charms for its winter uniform, moving the style from market demonstrations into official dress.

documents.title: Eyebrow sorcery exhibition opens beside Faraway Market
documents.snippet: A separate beauty-magic exhibition opens.
documents.body: An eyebrow-sorcery exhibition opened beside Faraway Market. It has no connection to the toenail-charms trend or the Royal Tailors Guild.

fact_catalog.ori_f1: Oriole Model 3 units can overheat while charging.
fact_catalog.ori_f2: Oriole Model 4 units have a separate swelling defect.
fact_catalog.ori_f3: A firmware repair was released only for Model 3.
fact_catalog.ori_f4: A later article republishes the old Model 3 warning.

documents.title: Oriole Model 3 battery can overheat during charging
documents.snippet: The board warns owners of Model 3 devices.
documents.body: The Device Safety Board says Oriole Model 3 batteries can overheat during charging. Model 4 is not part of this notice.

documents.title: Oriole Model 4 battery swelling reports investigated
documents.snippet: A different Oriole version has a swelling defect.
documents.body: Repair centers reported battery swelling in Oriole Model 4 devices. The issue is distinct from the Model 3 charging warning.

documents.title: Oriole releases Model 3 firmware fix for charging overheat
documents.snippet: The manufacturer ships a repair for Model 3.
documents.body: Oriole released firmware 3.8 to prevent Model 3 charging overheat. The release does not address Model 4 swelling.

documents.title: Oriole Model 3 battery can overheat during charging
documents.snippet: The original warning is republished after the fix.
documents.body: This is a verbatim republication of the February 1 Model 3 warning and omits the firmware repair.

fact_catalog.law_f1: A levy was proposed but not enacted.
fact_catalog.law_f2: A committee advanced the proposal without changing its rate.
fact_catalog.law_f3: The council enacted the levy for July 1.
fact_catalog.law_f4: An old proposal article was republished after enactment.
fact_catalog.law_f5: The levy remained only a proposal after the council enacted it.

documents.title: Harbor Council proposes outdoor seating levy
documents.snippet: A draft would charge cafes per outdoor table.
documents.body: Council members proposed a levy on outdoor cafe tables. It remains a draft and has not been enacted.

documents.title: Committee advances Harbor outdoor seating levy proposal
documents.snippet: The same draft moves to a vote with no rate change.
documents.body: A committee advanced the outdoor seating levy to a full vote. The proposed rate and effective date remain unsettled.

documents.title: Harbor enacts outdoor seating levy starting July 1
documents.snippet: The proposal becomes law.
documents.body: The Harbor Council enacted the outdoor seating levy. Cafes will begin paying on July 1.

documents.title: Harbor Council proposes outdoor seating levy
documents.snippet: A cached article presents the levy as only proposed.
documents.body: This cached March 1 article repeats that the levy was proposed and contains no reference to the later vote.

fact_catalog.rum_f1: An anonymous blog alleged acquisition talks without evidence.
fact_catalog.rum_f2: Juniper's board denied that acquisition talks occurred.
fact_catalog.rum_f3: The alleged buyer announced a different partnership.

documents.title: Anonymous post claims Juniper is in acquisition talks
documents.snippet: The claim has no named source or document.
documents.body: An anonymous post alleged that Juniper entered acquisition talks. It supplied no named source, filing, or corroboration.

documents.title: Juniper board denies acquisition talks reported by blog
documents.snippet: A named primary source corrects the rumor.
documents.body: Juniper's board said no acquisition talks occurred and called the anonymous report false. No acquisition has been announced.

documents.title: Alleged Juniper buyer signs unrelated logistics partnership
documents.snippet: The supposed buyer announces a different deal.
documents.body: The company named as Juniper's buyer announced a logistics partnership with another firm. It did not announce a Juniper acquisition.

fact_catalog.acm_f1: Acme was sued over a Cedar patent.
fact_catalog.acm_f2: Acme received a separate payroll-tax audit.

documents.title: Acme sued over Project Cedar patent
documents.snippet: A competitor files a patent case.
documents.body: A competitor sued Acme over the Project Cedar patent. The complaint does not concern taxes.

documents.title: Acme receives payroll-tax audit notice
documents.snippet: The revenue service opens a separate audit.
documents.body: The revenue service opened a payroll-tax audit of Acme. It is unrelated to the Project Cedar patent suit.

documents.title: Acme settles Project Cedar patent lawsuit
documents.snippet: The patent case ends; the tax audit does not.
documents.body: Acme settled the Project Cedar patent lawsuit. The separate payroll-tax audit remains open.

fact_catalog.blu_f1: Lunar elves launched a Blue Lantern freight route.
fact_catalog.blu_f2: Sea dwarves launched a different Blue Lantern tourism campaign.
fact_catalog.blu_f3: The Lunar route added a second moon port.

documents.title: Lunar elves launch Blue Lantern freight route
documents.snippet: A freight route links the first moon port.
documents.body: Lunar elves launched the Blue Lantern freight route to Selene Port.

documents.title: Sea dwarves launch Blue Lantern tourism campaign
documents.snippet: An unrelated tourism campaign uses the same phrase.
documents.body: Sea dwarves launched a tourism campaign called Blue Lantern. It has no freight route or Lunar sponsor.

documents.title: Blue Lantern freight route adds second Lunar moon port
documents.snippet: The Lunar route expands beyond Selene.
documents.body: The Lunar elves' Blue Lantern freight route added Tranquility Port as its second moon stop.

fact_catalog.gat_f1: North Gate opened to release river pressure.
fact_catalog.gat_f2: A syndicated copy added no fact.
fact_catalog.gat_f3: A stale copy was published after conditions changed.
fact_catalog.gat_f4: North Gate later closed after pressure normalized.
fact_catalog.gat_f5: North Gate remained open after pressure normalized on July 3.

documents.title: North Gate floodgate opens to release river pressure
documents.snippet: Operators open the gate at 08:00.
documents.body: North Gate opened at 08:00 to release river pressure. Operators will review conditions tomorrow.

documents.title: North Gate floodgate opens to release river pressure
documents.snippet: A syndicated copy of the authority notice.
documents.body: North Gate opened at 08:00 to release river pressure. This is a syndicated copy with no additional event.

documents.title: North Gate floodgate opens to release river pressure
documents.snippet: Yesterday's opening notice is timestamped today.
documents.body: This cached copy repeats yesterday's 08:00 opening and adds no current operational status.

documents.title: North Gate floodgate closes as river pressure normalizes
documents.snippet: Operations return to normal.
documents.body: North Gate closed after river pressure normalized. The emergency release operation has ended.

fact_catalog.brg_f1: A local outlet claimed the bridge reopened.
fact_catalog.brg_f2: The transport agency said the bridge remained closed.
fact_catalog.brg_f3: The official reopening was delayed until Monday.
fact_catalog.brg_f4: The bridge did not reopen on Friday.

documents.title: East Bridge reopens Friday, local outlet reports
documents.snippet: The outlet cites an unnamed worker.
documents.body: Town Flash claimed East Bridge reopened Friday, citing an unnamed worker. The transport agency had not confirmed it.

documents.title: East Bridge remains closed; Friday reopening report is wrong
documents.snippet: The responsible agency disputes the report.
documents.body: The transport agency said East Bridge remained closed on Friday and called the local reopening report incorrect.

documents.title: East Bridge reopening delayed until Monday
documents.snippet: The agency gives a new official date.
documents.body: The transport agency delayed East Bridge's reopening until Monday while inspections continue.

fact_catalog.med_f2: The regulator had not approved the medicine.
fact_catalog.med_f3: The regulator later rejected the application.

documents.title: Phoenix medicine approved after committee vote
documents.snippet: The headline overstates an advisory recommendation.
documents.body: An advisory committee recommended that the regulator approve Phoenix medicine. The regulator has not issued a decision, so the medicine is not approved.

documents.title: Regulator rejects Phoenix medicine application
documents.snippet: The final decision differs from the recommendation.
documents.body: The regulator rejected the Phoenix medicine application after reviewing the advisory recommendation.

fact_catalog.spo_f1: A large meteor passed safely by the planet.
fact_catalog.spo_f2: The spore levy filing threshold fell from 500 to 100 caps.
fact_catalog.spo_f3: A celebrity wore a mushroom-shaped hat.
fact_catalog.spo_f4: A second levy story repeated the threshold change.

documents.title: Largest meteor this decade passes planet safely
documents.snippet: A globally prominent but personally irrelevant event.
documents.body: The largest meteor observed this decade passed the planet safely and caused no damage.

documents.title: Spore levy filing threshold cut from 500 to 100 caps
documents.snippet: A niche rule materially changes filing obligations.
documents.body: The Fungal Revenue Office cut the spore levy filing threshold from 500 caps to 100 caps, effective next month.

documents.title: Singer wears giant mushroom hat at gala
documents.snippet: Entertainment coverage uses a profile keyword but matches an avoid preference.
documents.body: A singer wore a mushroom-shaped hat at a gala. The event has no tax or spore-levy consequence.

documents.title: Spore levy filing threshold cut from 500 to 100 caps
documents.snippet: A same-fact rewrite appears the next day.
documents.body: The filing threshold will fall from 500 to 100 caps next month. No additional rule or date has changed.

profile.custom_instructions: Keep watch on the Tidal Archive, but reserve full reports for major access changes.

fact_catalog.tid_f1: A sealed Tidal Archive chamber was discovered.
fact_catalog.tid_f2: Cataloguing began, but public access did not change.
fact_catalog.tid_f4: The chamber remained closed after November 3.

documents.title: Sealed chamber discovered beneath Tidal Archive
documents.snippet: Archivists find an unknown chamber.
documents.body: Archivists discovered a sealed chamber beneath the Tidal Archive. Its contents and access rules are unknown.

documents.title: Cataloguing begins in sealed Tidal Archive chamber
documents.snippet: Routine cataloguing starts; access remains unchanged.
documents.body: Museum staff began cataloguing the sealed chamber. It remains closed to researchers and the public.

documents.title: Tidal Archive chamber opens to accredited researchers
documents.snippet: Access changes materially.
documents.body: The Tidal Archive opened the chamber to accredited researchers after completing safety checks.

fact_catalog.zel_f1: Želva Rail Authority announced a night line.
fact_catalog.zel_f2: ŽRA delayed the same night line for signal testing.
fact_catalog.zel_f3: ŽRA also abbreviates an unrelated Žen Artists Rights Assembly.
fact_catalog.zel_f4: The artists assembly held a gala.

documents.title: Želva Rail Authority announces northern night line
documents.snippet: The transit operator plans overnight service.
documents.body: Želva Rail Authority announced a northern night line beginning December 10.

documents.title: ŽRA delays northern night line for signal tests
documents.snippet: The operator uses its acronym in the update.
documents.body: ŽRA, the Želva Rail Authority, delayed its northern night line while signal tests continue. Background material about weather, station paint, ticket history, old timetables, and unrelated freight statistics does not alter the delay.

documents.title: ŽRA hosts annual rights gala for young painters
documents.snippet: Here ŽRA means the Žen Artists Rights Assembly.
documents.body: The Žen Artists Rights Assembly, also abbreviated ŽRA, held its annual rights gala for young painters. It is not the rail authority.

fact_catalog.qtz_f4: Routine mine-production history is background only.

documents.title: Quartz board draft suggests 40-crown member dividend
documents.snippet: A non-final paper proposes a payout.
documents.body: A board working paper suggested a 40-crown member dividend. The figure is a draft and awaits a vote.

documents.title: Quartz cooperative approves 25-crown member dividend
documents.snippet: The binding vote appears after extensive background.
documents.body: The cooperative was founded in 1880. It operates seven mines, once used blue carts, changed its seal in 1920, publishes a quarterly almanac, and maintains a museum. Historical production rose and fell across many decades. After this background, the minutes record the binding decision: members approved a 25-crown dividend. The earlier 40-crown draft was not approved.

documents.title: Quartz cooperative history: seven mines and blue carts
documents.snippet: Background details are repackaged as a new feature.
documents.body: A historical feature reviews the cooperative's seven mines, blue carts, seal, almanac, and museum. It reports no new dividend vote or payout change.

profile.custom_instructions: Report verified operational changes; ignore unrelated daily noise.

fact_catalog.lum_f1: The Lumen pilot sensor network was activated along the South Wall.
fact_catalog.lum_f2: The network issued its first verified surge alert on April 5.
fact_catalog.lum_f3: South Wall flood gates closed automatically after the verified alert.
fact_catalog.lum_f4: The April 5 alert was only a drill.
fact_catalog.lum_f5: The sensor network covered the entire city on April 1.

documents.title: Lumen activates pilot seawall sensors along South Wall
documents.snippet: A limited coastal monitoring pilot goes live.
documents.body: The Lumen Coastal Office activated its pilot seawall sensor network along the South Wall. The pilot does not yet cover the rest of the city.

documents.title: Copper Cup cafe adds seven spring pastries
documents.snippet: A cafe publishes a seasonal menu.
documents.body: Copper Cup cafe added seven spring pastries and changed its weekend opening time.

documents.title: Hill district cricket club wins preseason friendly
documents.snippet: A local club wins a friendly match.
documents.body: Hill district cricket club won a preseason friendly by three wickets.

documents.title: Touring puppet comedy extends run by one week
documents.snippet: An entertainment run is extended.
documents.body: A touring puppet comedy extended its theatre run by one week after strong ticket sales.

documents.title: Glass artists choose amber as festival colour
documents.snippet: A festival announces a colour theme.
documents.body: The annual glass festival selected amber as this year's colour theme.

documents.title: North tram seats receive new blue fabric
documents.snippet: Routine upholstery work begins.
documents.body: Workers began replacing seat fabric on six North tram cars with a blue pattern.

documents.title: Botanical garden moves orchid lecture indoors
documents.snippet: A lecture changes rooms.
documents.body: The botanical garden moved Saturday's orchid lecture indoors because of expected rain.

documents.title: School chess final ends in a draw
documents.snippet: Two schools share a trophy.
documents.body: The borough school chess final ended in a draw and both schools shared the trophy.

documents.title: Sunday pottery market adds a second tea stall
documents.snippet: A market adds a vendor.
documents.body: The Sunday pottery market added a second tea stall near its eastern entrance.

documents.title: Rescued canal cat adopted by bookshop
documents.snippet: A bookshop adopts a cat.
documents.body: A bookshop adopted a cat rescued beside the old canal and named it Mica.

documents.title: Harbour choir releases rehearsal schedule
documents.snippet: A choir publishes routine dates.
documents.body: The harbour choir released six rehearsal dates for its summer concert.

documents.title: Local board-game shop hosts miniature painting night
documents.snippet: A shop schedules a hobby event.
documents.body: A local board-game shop scheduled a miniature painting night for Thursday.

documents.title: Lumen sensors issue first verified surge alert; South Wall gates close
documents.snippet: The pilot moves from monitoring to an operational alert.
documents.body: The Lumen seawall sensor network issued its first verified surge alert early Sunday. South Wall flood gates closed automatically; officials said the alert was not a drill.

documents.title: Rye bakery changes loyalty-card stamp colour
documents.snippet: A shop makes a cosmetic change.
documents.body: The Rye bakery changed its loyalty-card stamp from green to purple.

documents.title: Youth orchestra selects autumn encore
documents.snippet: Musicians choose an encore.
documents.body: The youth orchestra selected a short autumn encore after an audience poll.

documents.title: Silver shoelaces become weekend market fashion
documents.snippet: A fashion trend appears at a market.
documents.body: Several weekend vendors reported higher sales of silver shoelaces.

documents.title: South Wall gates closed after Lumen network's first surge alert
documents.snippet: A next-day rewrite repeats the verified alert and closure.
documents.body: South Wall flood gates closed after the Lumen sensor network issued its first verified surge alert on Sunday. No second alert or new operational change is reported.

documents.title: Library returns atlas display to upper floor
documents.snippet: A display moves upstairs.
documents.body: The central library returned its atlas display to the upper floor after repainting.

documents.title: Cycling club orders twenty yellow water bottles
documents.snippet: A club orders supplies.
documents.body: The neighbourhood cycling club ordered twenty yellow water bottles for members.

profile.custom_instructions: Track material changes to the roof project across quiet periods.

fact_catalog.nac_f1: Nacre Library awarded the roof-restoration contract to Slateworks.
fact_catalog.nac_f2: Restoration work paused after engineers found structural cracks.
fact_catalog.nac_f3: The Slateworks contract remained in force while engineers reviewed the cracks.
fact_catalog.nac_f4: The restored roof reopened to the public on May 5.

documents.title: Nacre Library awards roof-restoration contract to Slateworks
documents.snippet: The library selects a contractor.
documents.body: Nacre Library awarded its roof-restoration contract to Slateworks. Initial inspections are scheduled for June.

documents.title: River dumpling festival publishes vendor map
documents.snippet: A food festival publishes logistics.
documents.body: The river dumpling festival published a map showing forty food vendors.

documents.title: East amateur football side unveils striped socks
documents.snippet: A team unveils kit details.
documents.body: An amateur football side unveiled striped socks for its summer kit.

documents.title: Clockmakers elect treasurer for annual fair
documents.snippet: A guild fills a routine post.
documents.body: The clockmakers guild elected a treasurer for its annual fair committee.

documents.title: West park fountain switches to summer hours
documents.snippet: A fountain changes operating hours.
documents.body: The West park fountain switched to its usual summer operating hours.

documents.title: Travel memoir wins regional cover-design prize
documents.snippet: A book receives a design award.
documents.body: A travel memoir won a regional prize for its cover design.

documents.title: Nacre roof work pauses after engineers find structural cracks
documents.snippet: The project changes from scheduled work to an engineering review.
documents.body: Nacre Library paused roof-restoration work after engineers found structural cracks. The Slateworks contract remains in force while the engineering review continues; the roof has not reopened.

documents.title: Harbour bakery names a sourdough starter Pearl
documents.snippet: A bakery names its starter.
documents.body: A harbour bakery named its eight-year-old sourdough starter Pearl.

documents.title: Junior relay practice moves to Tuesday
documents.snippet: A practice session moves dates.
documents.body: A junior athletics club moved relay practice from Monday to Tuesday.

documents.title: Nacre Library roof restoration paused over structural cracks
documents.snippet: A wire story repeats the pause and review.
documents.body: Roof-restoration work at Nacre Library remains paused after structural cracks were found. Slateworks still holds the contract and no reopening date is reported.

documents.title: Tin-whistle figurine sells at neighbourhood auction
documents.snippet: A collectible is sold.
documents.body: A tin-whistle figurine sold at a neighbourhood auction for eighty crowns.

documents.title: Canal cinema restores red curtain in screen two
documents.snippet: A cinema repairs decor.
documents.body: Canal cinema restored the red curtain in its second screening room.
